title: Define product roles and a career framework
summary: Clear roles and levels help PMs know what is expected and how to grow. Base them on skills and scope, not just titles.

beginner: List the product roles you have today and what each does.
Describe each level by what the person owns and the skills they show.
Start from a published framework rather than from scratch.
Test the draft with PMs at different levels.
Agree it with HR and leaders.
intermediate: Include both people-leader and senior individual paths.
Use the framework for hiring, reviews and development plans.
Keep it short enough to use in a conversation.
experienced: Align product levels with engineering and design levels.
Link the framework to pay and promotion with HR.
Review it each year as roles change.

canDelegateTo.task: Align with HR policies, pay and promotion

toolExamples.confluence: Publish the framework with examples for each level.

pitfalls: A framework too long to use

sources.title: Product manager role and levels (Government Digital and Data Capability Framework)
